title: IngramSpark cover template observed metadata
description: Observed geometry from an IngramSpark Cover Template Generator request. Compared to book.yml print.trim / print.cover at validation time; not a second hand-maintained trim authority.

page_count.description: Interior page count the template was generated for (PDF page count as submitted).

color_mode.description: Interior color mode the template assumed.

media_box.description: Full-wrap PDF media box (front + spine + back + bleed), not trim size.

barcode_supplied.description: True when the wrap includes a supplied barcode; must match print.cover.barcode_mode.

spine_text.description: True when the wrap includes spine text (forbidden for paperback under 48 pages).
